newsitem.title: USA: Siemens US unit forms venture to sell data system.
newsitem.headline: Siemens US unit forms venture to sell data system.

text.p: Siemens Business Communication Systems Inc said Monday it formed a joint venture with SABRE Decision Technologies to market real-time data technology for the U.S. utility industry.

Siemens said its "ProCenter" call center expertise and SABRE's information modeling and "mining" technology would allow utilities to identify opportunities and tailor products for individual customers when they phone.

For example, if a customer calls a utility inquiring about rebate programs for energy-saving lamps, the integrated system would deliver the customer profile to the service representative's computer screen.
The agent could then bundle a tailored offering that fits the caller's purchasing patterns, Siemens said in a statement.
The integrated telecommunication and information system will be available by mid-summer.

"Deregulation of the utility industry has brought new competitive challenges to the utility companies. Together, Siemens and SABRE Decision Technologies can help utility companies to address these challenges by offering tools that can improve customer satisfaction, reduce operating costs, increase revenue and retain solutions," said Tim Steele, director of industry marketing at Siemens Business Communications.
Siemens Business Communication Systems is one of the U.S. affilates of Siemens AG of Germany. SABRE Decision Techologies, based in Forth Worth, Texas, is a division of SABRE Group Inc.
